entries.title: Explicit Re-review Intents
entries.compatibility: No schema change. Pending intents never expire for capacity; expires_at is a load-scaled one-time waiting-notice threshold. Remediation-watch receipts follow ordinary admission and settle atomically with automatic closure or same-head restoration. Cycle-cap settlement rechecks the routed row snapshot; newer priority requests retain pending intent. Priority requests coalesce worker receipts at the same head while retaining the original threshold. Positively unstarted launches return their session-scoped intent to pending. Superseded bot review dismissal grants no merge authority.
